title: Four Lions
starring: Riz Ahmed, Kayvan Novak, Nigel Lindsay, Adeel Akhtar
summary: During a devastating zombie outbreak, four selfish friends abandon Britain's organised evacuation and begin the dangerous journey back to Chippenham. After escaping soldiers, crossing an infested theme park and sheltering at a deserted wildlife park, they form an unlikely alliance with four escaped lions that may be their only protection from the infected.
